directionReference.prompt: Art-direction revision of the isometric tank battlefield: contiguous large flat-top hex landforms for a real-time volcanic frontier refinery, with meadow, ochre earth, basalt, steel service deck and hot fissures. Original premium 1990s arcade pixel-art craftsmanship; no square tiles or static backdrop.

prototypeLandform.decision: kept as a concept; its repeated whole-landform detail was too conspicuous at gameplay scale

G.prompt: Square overhead pixel-art olive frontier meadow material, small hand-clustered grass tufts, dry gold blades, slate pebbles, a few white wildflowers and ochre soil flecks; even coverage, no tile borders or large objects.

D.prompt: Companion square overhead pixel-art ochre compacted earth with straw tufts, small stones, shell grit, tire-scuffed patches and tiny grass intrusions; same material scale as meadow, no tile borders.

B.prompt: Companion square overhead pixel-art dark slate basalt, irregular angular plates and cracks, charcoal facets, warm olive dust and sparse mineral highlights; flat material, no cliff or tile border.

A.recipe: basalt source graded to ash with generated orange fissures

M.prompt: Companion square overhead pixel-art worn refinery steel deck, small gunmetal plates, grates, rivets, rust, cream scuffs and restrained industrial-yellow paint; flat material, no tile border.
